message.reasoning:
The user wants me to calculate $17 \times 23$ and show the work briefly.

    17
  x 23
  ----

Step 1: Multiply 17 by 3 (the ones digit of 23).
$17 \times 3 = (10 \times 3) + (7 \times 3) = 30 + 21 = 51$.

Step 2: Multiply 17 by 20 (the tens digit of 23).
$17 \times 20 = 17 \times 2 \times 10 = 34 \times 10 = 340$.

Step 3: Add the results from Step 1 and Step 2.
$51 + 340 = 391$.

Alternative method (Distributive Property):
$17 \times 23 = 17 \times (20 + 3)$
$17 \times 20 = 340$
$17 \times 3 = 51$
$340 + 51 = 391$.

The result is 391. I will present the standard multiplication method briefly.
